description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Financial" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Customer files complaint">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineOutcome" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Log" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Review" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Determine" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Determine_Notify" sourceRef="Task_DetermineOutcome" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Resolved" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mark_End" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer provides feedback after resolution">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Feedback provided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Feedback" name="Organization feedback intake" processRef="Process_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Decision notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Feedback after complaint resolution" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
